verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs show a dedicated Alerts system with Slack and PagerDuty integrations plus email notifications (docs-17/18/19/32), and Ownership/Issue-Status rules support project-based routing, matching the core of the SRE alert-routing story. However the evidence pack doesn't explicitly detail the specific threshold types (new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count) or environment-based filtering, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of these granular rule options. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of frequency-spike and affected-user-count alert conditions, environment-scoped rule configuration, and third-party corroboration of alert reliability.
